candidates.title: Shearwater striker
candidates.summary: Top-down indigo dart facing down, swept wings with brass trim, and one amber spark-coil ahead of the nose.
limitations: Concept art only. Not registered in the runtime.
The spark-coil sits just ahead of the metal nose and is joined by short arcs, so this neutral frame includes a small muzzle effect.
A few tail-fin pixels keep a slight olive cast from the chroma edge. They do not read at about 60 px of body width.
Silhouette was checked on a flattened preview at about 60 px of body width, on white and near-black, not in the game.

candidates.title: Galvanic jelly floater
candidates.summary: Top-down indigo bell facing down, brass rim, amber core, and seven tentacles, with the shorter center tentacle unlit.
limitations: Concept art only. Not registered in the runtime.
Seven tentacles were rendered. The center tentacle is shorter and has no tip spark.
The bell is a flat overhead disk. Dome thickness and the underside are unknown.
Silhouette was checked on a flattened preview at about 60 px of body width, on white and near-black, not in the game.
